We are not against evil, we are not against evil.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 35 ([[Translated#Dialogue|Translated Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Warden''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it only appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode exclusive [[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]], [[Oops! All slimes!]] and [[Vanguard (Challenge)|Vanguard]] challenges. It has very high health and high defense but an average speed. It has one ability, where it fires a blue laser from its chest to stun towers in a wide area. The '''Warden''' also has the [[Stun Immunity]], which prevents the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] from stunning it, slowing it down instead and preventing knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] from knocking it back. ==Appearance== The '''Warden''' is a large humanoid entity with a waist in its rig. It has a dark blue skin color and the ends of its limbs are covered in a cyan fluid. It has an energy pack on its back with an antenna that emits yellow sparks along with six batteries connected to it. Its chest has a gaping cavity, revealing its rib cage and a pink cube inside, which emits light blue particles. It has red wounds that span horizontally across the chest cavity. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Warden''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Like all other tanky enemies, high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] should be used to take the '''Warden''' down. **The [[Commander]] should be used to boost the firerate of these towers. **Be aware that the [[Engineer]]'s sentries will take damage from the '''Warden's''' ''Heartfelt Laser''. *The '''Warden's''' ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability can easily kill units with lower health, such as the [[Gunner Elf]] or [[Tommy Goon 2]], as it deals damage to units. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] cannot be stunned by the '''Warden's''' ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] deal full collision damage to the '''Warden''', regardless of its defense, making them quite useful. **Do note that their ranged damage is still decreased. * It is recommended to place your towers away from the path to avoid getting stunned by the '''Warden's''' ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability. *It may be viable to have a cheap distraction tower, like a Level 0 [[Commander]], to distract the '''Warden's''' ''Heartfelt Laser'' from your main offensive towers. *When the '''Warden''' spawns, it will not use its ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability for a few seconds. Use this period of time to defeat the '''Warden''' before it can stun any towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers from the '''Warden's''' stun. **Do note that this will be ineffective while the '''Warden''' is still firing its ''Heartfelt Laser'', as the towers will be continuously stunned until the ability is over. *The [[Gladiator]]'s stun blocking is ineffective against the '''Warden''', as the first stun will be blocked, but not any subsequent stuns from the continuous ''Heartfelt Laser''. *Stalling towers like the [[Cryomancer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to slow down the '''Warden'''. **However, because of its large size, freezing towers and the [[Warden]] will slow it down for a shorter amount of time. **Additionally, the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it because of its stun immunity while knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back. **Do note that the '''Warden''' will not stop using its ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability when frozen or stunned. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Jester]] or [[Freezer]] can help to reduce the '''Warden's''' defense. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:NuclearMonsterBeam.ogg]] |When the '''Warden''' performs ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability |- |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseWarden.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PollutedThumbnail2.png|'''Warden''' on the game thumbnail. Tower Defense Simulator- 🌵 BADLANDS Trailer! 🌵|'''Warden''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} WardenIconIG.png|'''Warden''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy is based on the [[w:c:Minecraft:Warden|Warden]] from ''Minecraft''. **The '''Warden's''' ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability is also inspired from the Sonic Boom attack of ''Minecraft's'' [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Warden Warden]. *Its ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability's hitbox is slightly shorter than where the laser displays. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''29 July 2022''' -
